From: laura_bennett@redwood.com

All — legal reviewed. Draft language below is ready for the PO redline: 

"""Acceptance and Activation Window: Customer may elect a staged activation consisting of (i) a Pilot Activation Period and (ii) a Production Activation. Billing for committed capacity will commence upon completion of the Production Activation. Customer's authorized signatory (the "Buyer CFO") shall have ten (10) business days following the end of the Pilot Activation Period (the "Acceptance Window") to provide written acceptance. If written acceptance is provided within the Acceptance Window, Customer shall be billed retroactively from the Production Activation date, and Redwood will apply a one-time credit equal to the difference between Pilot pricing and the committed rate for the Pilot Activation Period. If written acceptance is not provided within the Acceptance Window, Redwood reserves the right to terminate the committed offer and continue service on a pay-as-you-go basis without credits."""

Two items to call out: capping credits (we propose cap equal to single pilot month invoice) and specifying the Production Activation objective (e.g., completion of onboarding checklist — we should attach the onboarding checklist to the PO).

I can produce a redline for the PO; recommend sending to HealthGrid with a highlighted acceptance window and credit cap.

Laura Bennett
